fallbacks: fallback: no type token at 150 %: each role is drawn with the token nearest 1.5 x its size (caption 11 -> heading-md 16, label 12 / body 13 -> heading-lg 20, heading-sm 14 / heading-md 16 -> display 24); the weight steps up with it
fallback: border.control (D03-D5 / D03-D6, PROPOSED) is not a token yet: control boundaries bind its values directly, border.hairline in dark and light, border.thick in high contrast

fallback: where no semantic alias resolves to a preset's §8.2 primitive in the board's theme, the swatch binds the same-hue stand-in and the live drawer rebinds it to the primitive (the validator refuses primitive colour binds)
kit choice: the shell chrome (TopBar, NavRail, StatusBar) and CMP-086's settings list drawn as neutral placeholders; only SCR-116's content, the PreviewTile and the env badges of board 08 are drawn
kit choice: the 200 % frame draws the 640 CSS px page at 1:1 in two 640 px strips (CSS y 0-800 and 800-1600); the device shows it at 2 x. The 640 x 400 CSS viewport is outlined on the first strip
live_checks: swatch 'Purple' (dark): rebind its fill from color.node.logic to palette.purple.400 (§8.2's primitive, BQ-8); read back that the check glyph stays color.text.inverse
zoom-200 strip 1: set the 'dashed · viewport 640 x 400 CSS' outline to dashed style (post-step), so its bottom edge does not strike through the heading under the 400 px fold
root 'E47-D03 / 05 text-150-zoom-200' at (24000, 0): read back the name exactly after the first section call; size 3280 x 1000
after touchTexts + relayout: the annotation column (estimated 602 px) ends inside the root (h 1000); raise the root's h to its end + 80 if not
frame 'SCR-116∕text-150 · dark': read back 1280 x 800 at (80, 80); clip on, no child spills
frame 'SCR-116∕zoom-200 · dark': read back 1280 x 800 at (1440, 80); clip on, no child spills

ambiguities: Board 05: no type token exists at 150 % or at 2 x: the text-150 frame maps each role to the token nearest 1.5 x (FALLBACKS type-150) and the zoom-200 frame draws the 640 CSS px page at 1:1 in two strips instead of a 2 x raster
